name: resume-tailor
description: Turn your real work into targeted, one-page LaTeX resumes. Connect local or GitHub repos (or just describe your work) to build verified accomplishment notes, then tailor a resume per job description (multi-JD batches in parallel), write matching cover letters and application-question answers in your voice, check keyword coverage deterministically, track every application with statuses and summaries, and drop in custom resume templates. Every bullet traces to real work - nothing is invented.
